Title: Check all elements are visible on the login page
Steps: 1. Open the login page.
Expected Result: The heading "Welcome back", the subtitle, the email field, the password field, the Sign in button, the "Forgot? Ask the TPM" text and the Light, Dark and System theme buttons are visible.

Title: Check the password is hidden and the email field type is email
Steps: 1. Open the login page.
Expected Result: The password field shows dots (type is password). The email field has type email.

Title: Show and hide the password "Secret123" using the eye button
Steps: 1. Type a password. 2. Click "Show password". 3. Click "Hide password".
Expected Result: After step 2 the password is readable. After step 3 it is hidden again. The typed text does not change.

Title: Press the Tab key on the email field and check the cursor moves to the password field
Steps: 1. Click the email field. 2. Press the Tab key.
Expected Result: The cursor moves to the password field.

Title: Click "Forgot? Ask the TPM" and check nothing opens
Steps: 1. Click "Forgot? Ask the TPM".
Expected Result: Nothing opens. The user stays on the login page. It is not a link.

Title: Login with valid email and valid password by clicking Sign in
Steps: 1. Type the valid email. 2. Type the valid password. 3. Click Sign in.
Expected Result: The workspace page opens.

Title: Login with valid email and valid password by pressing Enter
Steps: 1. Type the valid email and password. 2. Press Enter.
Expected Result: The workspace page opens.

Title: Login with valid email in UPPERCASE and valid password
Steps: 1. Type the valid email in UPPERCASE. 2. Type the valid password. 3. Click Sign in.
Expected Result: The workspace page opens.

Title: Login with valid email having spaces before and after, and valid password
Steps: 1. Type the valid email with spaces before and after. 2. Type the password. 3. Click Sign in.
Expected Result: The workspace page opens.

Title: Login with valid email and valid password and check the server answers with status 200
Steps: 1. Log in with valid details.
Expected Result: The server answers the login request with status 200.

Title: Login with valid email and valid password, then reload the page and stay logged in
Steps: 1. Log in with valid details. 2. Reload the page.
Expected Result: The user stays on the workspace page and is not sent back to login.

Title: Login with wrong email "no.such.user.qa@theitzon.com", then login again with valid email and valid password
Steps: 1. Log in with a wrong email. 2. Clear both fields. 3. Log in with valid details.
Expected Result: The workspace page opens.
